scope: Motion H67 ep34 lossless sparsity, skip and energy candidate mining
first_principles_rule: A candidate must reduce same-resource cycle, physical bytes, or energy after descriptor, fetch, update, commit, metadata, port and queue costs. Operation-count-only reduction is killed.

candidates.name: Typed-Signed Bundle-Gustavson
direct_prior: ELSA bundled AER and mini-batch spiking Gustavson
candidates.h67_delta: Reuse one weight row across multiple independent typed signed token/context descriptors while preserving value, sign, terminal and Acc24 ownership under the same K8, bank, port, bandwidth and 240-KiB constraints.
not_duplicate: C1 captures Conv activation parent/product inside a task
M24 is T10 temporal cohort coefficient fusion

candidates.name: Adaptive Codeword/Event Stream
candidates.h67_delta: Select the shortest exact physical packet among unit bitmap, layer-codeword bitmap, typed index list and raw escape while preserving C2 token/context/terminal semantics.
not_duplicate: M24 crosses T10 cohorts; ACES does not
M231 is fixed binary raw4 transpose
C2 service begins after source tuple decoding

candidates.name: Lossless Block-Width/Zero Compression
candidates.h67_delta: Encode the exact ep34 INT8 C1/C2 service tile with minimum signed width or exact all-zero tag, then reconstruct byte-identical INT8 before the existing service.
not_duplicate: C1 reuses runtime products, not static payload
C2 does not compress weight memory
M102 reads fixed three-beat INT8 rows
candidates.blocked_by: M1526 ep34 INT8 Q1-Q4 authority and miter

killed_or_existing: C1 product capture retained; no fourth Conv matcher
C2 K8 retained; no generic OOO or new multi-lane decoder
M501 APEC is direct ExSpike prior and not revived
G10 empty tile killed as performance
G15, lazy-PWP and H1 killed as performance
M523 decoder packing is support only
FC1 held-context and BN materialization elision are existing lines
ESDA submanifold Conv changes semantics and is not lossless H67 hardware
zero descriptor to zero fetch is an assertion/measurement closure, not new RTL
next_48h: Define one additive ep34 support/value capture shared by TSBG and ACES without redoing M1458.
Run ACES exact byte census first and kill below 30-percent physical transport reduction.
Run TSBG B2/B4/B8 against a strong ordinary row-buffer baseline and keep only same-resource cycle or byte/energy wins.
Run LBWC only after ep34 INT8 Q1-Q4 authority arrives; kill immediately if service-tile extremes prevent compression.
Promote at most one minimal RTL and do not block decoder-complete Table-A, C1 rebind or production power.
overall_verdict: TSBG is the only candidate with material DATE-upside. ACES and LBWC are energy/traffic completeness candidates. Any operation-only win is killed.
